criteria.basis: experiment 46: on QB the FR D_s/QNR (toolbox 1.0 and original-paper variants) rank the ground truth below model outputs, so they cannot veto
criteria.primary_RR: PanCollection RR20; candidate minus same-condition control; seed-mean PSNR > 0, SAM < 0, ERGAS < 0; with 3 seeds also PSNR > 0 in at least 2 of 3 seeds

guards_ground_truth.RR2: RR test scenes degraded once more (dataset Wald operator), GT = RR MS: seed-mean PSNR >= -0.05 dB and SAM <= +0.02 deg
guards_ground_truth.FR_WALD: FR test scenes degraded by the same operator, GT = native FR MS: seed-mean PSNR >= -0.05 dB and SAM <= +0.02 deg
guards_ground_truth.FR_OBS: interior RMSE (DN) of observation(FR output) - FR MS: seed-mean ratio to control <= 1.10

labels.개선: primary passes and all three guards pass
labels.부분 개선: primary passes but a guard fails, or only part of PSNR/SAM/ERGAS improves

criteria.adoption: a baseline-model change additionally requires 3 seeds; single-seed results are labelled with their seed
criteria.new_FR_indices: an FR index may enter decisions only after passing the experiment 46 ground-truth ranking test
criteria.tolerance_reference: experiment 43 C0 seed SD: RR PSNR 0.056 dB, SAM 0.021 deg
